source_note: RxNav's live Drug-Drug Interaction API was permanently discontinued by NLM in Jan 2024. This file is a manually curated rule set based on well-documented, publicly known interactions (ONC High-Priority style pairs), cross-referenced against openFDA label warnings. See README Scope & Limitations.

interaction_rules.description: Combined use significantly increases risk of bleeding due to additive anticoagulant/antiplatelet effects.
NSAIDs increase bleeding risk when combined with warfarin; also raises GI bleed risk independently.
NSAIDs can reduce the antihypertensive effect of ACE inhibitors and increase risk of kidney impairment.
PPIs may alter metformin absorption slightly; generally low clinical significance but monitored.
Rare reports of altered statin metabolism with some antibiotics; low-risk combination overall.
NSAIDs can blunt the blood-pressure-lowering effect of beta-blockers.
PPIs can reduce levothyroxine absorption; dosing timing separation is typically recommended.
Antibiotics can alter gut flora affecting vitamin K synthesis, potentiating warfarin's effect.
